prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1443; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for side impact collision at intersection. Insured reports other vehicle entered intersection against signal and struck driver's side. Police report requested. Vehicle inspection scheduled.

Entry 2: Claimant identified as represented by counsel. All further contact to go through attorney's office. Letter of representation on file. Claimant reports neck and upper back pain consistent with whiplash, has sought initial medical evaluation.

Entry 3: Recorded statement obtained from insured. Insured states light was green for their direction of travel. Two independent witnesses identified in police report, contact information noted. Photos of vehicle damage received and reviewed.

Entry 4: Medical records requested from claimant's treating provider through counsel. Preliminary review shows diagnosis of cervical strain and outpatient physical therapy referral. Liability appears probable against other driver based on witness accounts and damage pattern.

Entry 5: Reserve adjusted to reflect soft tissue injury and ongoing treatment. Demand package from counsel expected after treatment concludes. Follow-up set to review records and evaluate settlement range once medical treatment status is confirmed.
